title: Viva la Vida
hook: Why do these chords feel like *glory and loss*?
cover_text: Triumphant *and* sad at the same time

chords.name: Db
chords.text: It starts on *D♭*, the IV. Not home. Already reaching.

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: Then *F minor*. The victory turns to loss.

chords.name: Db
chords.text: Around again: the glory *never gets to stay*.

question: Did you get it before the reveal? Be honest 👇
